# Support for Domestic Politicians

Sandu remains more popular than Sor or Dodon, especially after 2023. Support for Sandu has decreased, while support for Dodon and Sor has declined.

```{r, echo = FALSE}
bop_panel %>%
  group_by(wave, date) %>%
  summarise(
    Sandu_mean = mean(Sandu, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sandu_sd = sd(Sandu, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sandu_n = sum(!is.na(Sandu)),
    Sandu_se = Sandu_sd / sqrt(Sandu_n),
    Sandu_lower = Sandu_mean - 1.96 * Sandu_se,
    Sandu_upper = Sandu_mean + 1.96 * Sandu_se,
    Dodon_mean = mean(Dodon, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dodon_sd = sd(Dodon, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dodon_n = sum(!is.na(Dodon)),
    Dodon_se = Dodon_sd / sqrt(Dodon_n),
    Dodon_lower = Dodon_mean - 1.96 * Dodon_se,
    Dodon_upper = Dodon_mean + 1.96 * Dodon_se,
    Sor_mean = mean(Sor, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sor_sd = sd(Sor, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sor_n = sum(!is.na(Sor)),
    Sor_se = Sor_sd / sqrt(Sor_n),
    Sor_lower = Sor_mean - 1.96 * Sor_se,
    Sor_upper = Sor_mean + 1.96 * Sor_se  
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Sandu_mean, Dodon_mean, Sor_mean, Sandu_lower, Sandu_upper, Dodon_lower, Dodon_upper, Sor_lower, Sor_upper),
    names_to = c("politician", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(Sandu|Dodon|Sor)_(.*)"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = mean, color = politician, 
                              group = politician)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = politician), 
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(1,4)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Mean Score")
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
domestic_leaders <- list(
  "Sandu" = glm(Sandu ~ Age.f + Gender + Ethnicity + Language_Questionnaire + Macro_Region + Ecology + Education + Socioeconomic + top_TV + top_internet + good + poverty + corruption + interethnic + war + Unification_For + Putin + EU_For + year, data = bop_panel),
    "Sor" = glm(Sor ~ Age.f + Gender + Ethnicity + Language_Questionnaire + Macro_Region + Ecology + Education + Socioeconomic + top_TV + top_internet + good + poverty + corruption + interethnic + war + Unification_For + Putin + EU_For + year, data = bop_panel),
  "Dodon" = glm(Dodon ~ Age.f + Gender + Ethnicity + Language_Questionnaire + Macro_Region + Ecology + Education + Socioeconomic + top_TV + top_internet + good + poverty + corruption + interethnic + war + Unification_For + Putin + EU_For + year, data = bop_panel)
)
```

*Sandu gains from: those identifying as Romanian, high level of education, worry about corruption and war, or support unification and EU membership.*

*Sandu loses from: those who identify as Russian or Ukrainain, complete the survey in Russian, reside in Gagauzia, or are more supportive of Putin.*

*Sandu and Dodon gain from those who think Moldova is heading in a good direction.*

*Those who think Moldova is heading in a good direction are more supportive of Sandu and Dodon.*

*Dodon and Sor gain more those identifying Gagauz, Russia, Ukrainian or Bulgarian, with a lower socioeconomic level, reside in the south, or are more supportive of Putin.*

*Dodon gains from: those with a lower level of education or name TV as an impotrant media source.*

*Sor gains from those who complete the survey in Russian or reside in the centre and north.*

*Dodon loses from those who complete the survey in Russian, have a high level of education, or support EU membership or unification.*

*Sor loses from those who reside in rural areas.*

*Dodon and Sor lose from those who worry about corruption.*


## Demographics
:::::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
modelplot(domestic_leaders, coef_map = coef_plot_demographics) + 
  aes(shape = model) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = 'black', alpha = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  xlab("Coefficient estimates and 95% CIs") +
  labs(caption = "Reference categories: Man (gender), Moldovan ethnicity), Romanian (questionnaire language), medium (education), medium (socioeconomic status)") +
  theme(plot.caption = element_textbox_simple(hjust = 0, halign = 0, margin = margin(t = 8)), plot.caption.position = "plot")
```
:::

::: {.column width="45%"}
- Age & gender: not significant
- Ethnicity:
  - Romanian: significant for Sandu (+)
  - Russian: significant for Dodon & Sor (+) and Sandu (-)
  - Ukrainian: significant for Dodon & Sor (+) and Sandu (-)
  - Gagauz: (only) significant for Dodon (+)
  - Bulgarian: significant for Dodon & Sor (+) 
  - Language of questionnaire: Russian significant for Sor (+) and Sandu and Dodon (-)
- Education:
  - Low: significant for Dodon (+)
  - High: significant for Sandu (+) and Dodon (-)
- Socioeconomic:
  - Low: significant for Dodon and Sor (+)
  - High: not significant 
  
:::
::::::

# Support for International Politicians

Support for Zelenskyy *and* Putin has declined over time. Zelenskyy remains less popular and has continued to decline over time, while support for Putin increased slightly in 2025.

```{r, echo = FALSE}
bop_panel %>%
  group_by(wave, date) %>%
  summarise(
    Putin_mean = mean(Putin, na.rm = TRUE),
    Putin_sd = sd(Putin, na.rm = TRUE),
    Putin_n = sum(!is.na(Putin)),
    Putin_se = Putin_sd / sqrt(Putin_n),
    Putin_lower = Putin_mean - 1.96 * Putin_se,
    Putin_upper = Putin_mean + 1.96 * Putin_se,
    Zelenskyy_mean = mean(Zelenskyy, na.rm = TRUE),
    Zelenskyy_sd = sd(Zelenskyy, na.rm = TRUE),
    Zelenskyy_n = sum(!is.na(Zelenskyy)),
    Zelenskyy_se = Zelenskyy_sd / sqrt(Zelenskyy_n),
    Zelenskyy_lower = Zelenskyy_mean - 1.96 * Zelenskyy_se,
    Zelenskyy_upper = Zelenskyy_mean + 1.96 * Zelenskyy_se) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Putin_mean, Putin_sd, Putin_n, Putin_se, Putin_lower, Putin_upper, 
             Zelenskyy_mean, Zelenskyy_sd, Zelenskyy_n, Zelenskyy_se, Zelenskyy_lower, Zelenskyy_upper),
    names_to = c("politician", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(Putin|Zelenskyy)_(.*)"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = mean, color = politician, 
                              group = politician)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = politician), 
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(1,4)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Mean Score (reverse scale)")
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
international_leaders <- list(
  "Putin" = glm(Putin ~ Age.f + Gender + Ethnicity + Language_Questionnaire + Macro_Region + Ecology + Education + Socioeconomic + top_TV + top_internet + good + poverty + corruption + interethnic + war + Unification_For + EU_For + year, data = bop_panel),
  "Zelenskyy" = glm(Zelenskyy ~ Age.f + Gender + Ethnicity + Language_Questionnaire + Macro_Region + Ecology + Education + Socioeconomic + top_TV + top_internet + good + poverty + corruption + interethnic + war + Unification_For + EU_For + year, 
                data = bop_panel)
)

```

*Zelenskyy gains from those with a higher level of education or socioeconomic level, identify as Romanian, complete the questionnaire in Romanian, support unification or EU membership, or worry about the war.*

*Zelenskyy loses from those who reside in Gagauzia.*

*Putin gains from those who identify as Russian, Ukrainian, Gagauz and Bulgarian, complete the survey in Russian, or reside in Gagauzia.*

*Putin loses from those who have a higher level of education, identify as Romanian, support EU membership or unification, or worry about war or corruption.*

# Unification

Support for unification as rising over time: from 21% in 2017 to over 35% in 2025.
```{r, echo = FALSE}
bop_panel %>%
  group_by(wave, date, Unification_For) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(wave, date) %>%
  mutate(
    total      = sum(n),
    percentage = n / total
  ) %>%
  filter(Unification_For == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    se    = sqrt(percentage * (1 - percentage) / total),
    lower = percentage - 1.96 * se,
    upper = percentage + 1.96 * se
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = percentage)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "black") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), 
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Percent")
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
unification_models_plot <- list(
  "EU" = glm(Unification_For ~ Age.f + Gender + Ethnicity + Language_Questionnaire + Macro_Region + Ecology + Education + Socioeconomic + top_TV + top_internet + good + poverty + corruption + interethnic + war + EU_For + year, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "NATO" = glm(Unification_For ~ Age.f + Gender + Ethnicity + Language_Questionnaire + Macro_Region + Ecology + Education + Socioeconomic + top_TV + top_internet + good + poverty + corruption + interethnic + war + Nato_For + year, data = bop_panel, family = binomial)
)
```

*Those supporting EU membership and NATO membership are more likely to support unification. Those identifying as Romanian as more likely to support unification.*

# International Organisations

```{r, echo = FALSE}
EU_support <- bop_panel %>%
  group_by(wave, date, EU_For) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(wave, date) %>%
  mutate(
    total      = sum(n),
    percentage = n / total
  ) %>%
  filter(EU_For == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    se    = sqrt(percentage * (1 - percentage) / total),
    lower = percentage - 1.96 * se,
    upper = percentage + 1.96 * se
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

EU_support$Variable <- "EU"
EU_support <- EU_support %>%
  select(-EU_For)

Eurasia_support <- bop_panel %>%
  group_by(wave, date, Eurasia_For) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(wave, date) %>%
  mutate(
    total      = sum(n),
    percentage = n / total
  ) %>%
  filter(Eurasia_For == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    se    = sqrt(percentage * (1 - percentage) / total),
    lower = percentage - 1.96 * se,
    upper = percentage + 1.96 * se
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

Eurasia_support$Variable <- "Eurasia"
Eurasia_support <- Eurasia_support %>%
  select(-Eurasia_For)

NATO_support <- bop_panel %>%
  group_by(wave, date, Nato_For) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(wave, date) %>%
  mutate(
    total      = sum(n),
    percentage = n / total
  ) %>%
  filter(Nato_For == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    se    = sqrt(percentage * (1 - percentage) / total),
    lower = percentage - 1.96 * se,
    upper = percentage + 1.96 * se
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

NATO_support$Variable <- "NATO"
NATO_support <- NATO_support %>%
  select(-Nato_For)

IO_support <- rbind(EU_support, NATO_support, Eurasia_support)

ggplot(IO_support, aes(x = date, y = percentage, color = Variable)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = Variable), 
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + 
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Percent")
```

*Support for joining the Eurasia Union gains from older respondents, those who identify as Russian, Ukrainian, Bulgarian, or Gagauz, complete the survey in Russia, have a lower socioeconomic level, reside in Gaguazia or the North, or in urban areas, worry about poverty, or name TV or the internet are important sources of media.*

*Support for joining the Eurasia Union loses from those with a high level of education, those who worry about corruption, or think that Moldova is going in a good direction.*

*Support for joining the EU gains from those who identify as Romanian, have a high level of education, high socioeconomic level, reside in rural areas, think that Moldova is heading in a good direction, or worry about war and corruption.*

*Support for joining the EU loses from those answering the survey in Russian, reside in Gagauzia, the centre or north, and those who worry about inter-ethnic relations.*

*Support for joining NATO gains from those who identify as Romanian, have a high socioeonomic level, think that Moldova is heading in a good direction, or worry about war or corruption.*

*Support for NATO loses from those who complete the survey in Russian, or reside in the centre or north.*

*Those residing in the South are less likely to support joining NATO but more likely to support joining the EU.*


```{r, include = FALSE}
IO_models <- list(
  "EU" = glm(EU_For ~ Age.f + Gender + Ethnicity + Language_Questionnaire + Macro_Region + Ecology + Education + Socioeconomic + top_TV + top_internet + good + poverty + corruption + interethnic + war + year, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "Eurasia" = glm(Eurasia_For ~ Age.f + Gender + Ethnicity + Language_Questionnaire + Macro_Region + Ecology + Education + Socioeconomic + top_TV + top_internet + good + poverty + corruption + interethnic + war + year, data = bop_panel, family = binomial),
  "NATO" = glm(Nato_For ~ Age.f + Gender + Ethnicity + Language_Questionnaire + Macro_Region + Ecology + Education + Socioeconomic + top_TV + top_internet + good + poverty + corruption + interethnic + war + year, data = bop_panel, family = binomial)
)
```

## Demographics
:::::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
modelplot(IO_models, coef_map = coef_plot_demographics, exponentiate = TRUE) + 
  aes(shape = model) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, color = 'black', alpha = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  xlab("Odds Ratios and 95% CIs") +
  labs(caption = "Reference categories: Man (gender), Moldovan ethnicity), Romanian (questionnaire language), medium (education), medium (socioeconomic status)") +
  theme(plot.caption = element_textbox_simple(hjust = 0, halign = 0, margin = margin(t = 8)), plot.caption.position = "plot")
```
:::
::: {.column width="45%"}
- Age: significant for Eurasia (+)
- Gender: women significant for EU and Eurasia (-)
- Ethnicity:
  - Romanian: significant for for EU and NATO (+), and Eurasia (-)
  - Russian, Ukrainian, Gagauz, Bulgarian: significant for EU and NATO (-), and Eurasia (+)
- Language: Russian as significant for EU and NATO (-) and Eurasia (+)
- Education: low as significant for EU (-); Eurasia and NATO not significant
  - High: significant for EU (+) and Eurasia (-)
- Socioeconomics: low as significant or EU (-) and Eurasia (+)
  - High: as significant for EU and NATO (+) and Eurasia (-)

:::
::::::

## Geography
:::::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
modelplot(IO_models, coef_map = coef_plot_locations, exponentiate = TRUE) + 
  aes(shape = model) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, color = 'black', alpha = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  xlab("Odds Ratios and 95% CIs") +
  labs(caption = "Reference categories: Chisinau (region), urban (ecology)") +
  theme(plot.caption.position = "plot")
```
:::
::: {.column width="45%"}
- Region
  - Gagauzia: significant for Eurasia (+) and EU (-)
  - Centre: significant for NATO and EU (-); not significant for Eurasia
  - North: significant for NATO and EU (-) and Eurasia (+)
  - South: significant fro NATO (-) and EU (+); not significant for Eurasia
- Ecology: rural as significant for EU (+) and Eurasia (-)

:::
::::::

  - Corruption: significant for EU and NATO (+) and Eurasia (-)
  - Inter-ethnic relations: significant for EU (-)
  - War: significant for EU and NATO (+)
- Media: TV as significant for Eurasia (+); not significant for others
  - Internet as significant for Eurasia (+)

## Support for EU AND Eurasia
```{r}
bop_panel %>%
  group_by(wave, date, EU_and_Eurasia) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(wave, date) %>%
  mutate(
    total      = sum(n),
    percentage = n / total
  ) %>%
  filter(EU_and_Eurasia == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    se    = sqrt(percentage * (1 - percentage) / total),
    lower = percentage - 1.96 * se,
    upper = percentage + 1.96 * se
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = percentage)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), 
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
```{r}
EU_and_Eurasia_model <- glm(Nato_For ~ Age + Gender + Ethnicity + Language_Questionnaire + Macro_Region + Ecology + Education + Socioeconomic + top_TV + top_internet + good + poverty + corruption + interethnic + war + year, data = bop_panel, family = binomial)
```

### Demographics
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
modelplot(EU_and_Eurasia_model, coef_map = coef_plot_demographics, exponentiate = TRUE) + 
  aes(shape = model) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, color = 'black', alpha = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  xlab("Odds Ratios and 95% CIs") +
  labs(caption = "Reference categories: Man (gender), Moldovan ethnicity), Romanian (questionnaire language), medium (education), medium (socioeconomic status)") +
  theme(plot.caption = element_textbox_simple(hjust = 0, halign = 0, margin = margin(t = 8)), plot.caption.position = "plot")
```
